property_summary: For any caller and any fuzzed final timestamp, executeBatchDeposit either reverts or leaves the contract unpaused/with the timestamp set only if the caller is the keeper; the mutant allows non-keepers and blocks the keeper, so a non-keeper call can succeed and change lastUnpauseTimestamp while the reference always reverts with CallerNotKeeper.
change_summary: Change the caller check from != to ==, allowing any non-keeper to call executeBatchDeposit while blocking the keeper.
